petersen_ord.note: The Petersen graph drawn on 'I_10: outer 5-cycle 0..4, spokes i ~ i+5, inner pentagram 5-7-9-6-8-5, from the literal ordered table; the natural relation is false outside 0..9 and on equal ends; isomorphic to petersen_kneser.

petersen_kneser.note: The Kneser graph KG(5,2): the ten two-element subsets of 'I_5 (exact cardinality subtype), adjacent iff disjoint; irreflexive since every vertex has two elements; isomorphic to petersen_ord.
